name: fleet-publish-ignore-block-ordering
title: Regenerate the managed ignore block before the fleet publish work commit
description: sd-ai-command-pack-fleet-publish.py builds the consumer work commit before anything regenerates the pack-managed .obsidian-kb block in the consumer's .gitignore. When a release changes that block, the tree only goes dirty later, when sd-ai-command-pack-housekeeping.sh runs the spec-KB updater at the merge gate, by which point the completion bundle is already published and the change cannot be folded into it. It cannot be repaired forward: a receipt spanning .gitignore is rejected as bundle_scope_invalid, and a second bundle is rejected as completion_archive_move_missing because the archive move happens once. Both consumers in campaign refresh-0.71.2-20260813T014138Z-c3 hit this on release 0.71.2 and each needed a reset, a rebuilt bundle, an operator-run force push, and a second review and CI cycle. Move the regeneration ahead of work_commit(), matching the argument form and working directory housekeeping uses, and add .gitignore to the dirty-tree allowlist so an already-regenerated tree also publishes.
creator: sdelmas
